text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills rose to 48.56 percent from 48.46 percent at the last sale on December 26, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.
The results of Monday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 49.76 million UAH 18.21 million UAH
Actual amount raised 44.38 million UAH 16.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 497,599 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 273,260 were competitive and 224,339 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 4.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.33 percent from 59.36 percent at the last sale on December 26, a central bank statement said.
The results of Monday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 43.00 million UAH 30.04 million UAH
Actual amount raised 33.18 million UAH 23.18 million UAH
The central bank sold 430,019 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 310,736 were competitive and 119,283 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 4.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 61.34 percent from 61.40 percent at the last sale on December 26, a central bank statement said.
The results of Monday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 6.42 million UAH 21.15 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.40 million UAH 14.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 64,212 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 45,130 were competitive and 19,082 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 4.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills was unchanged at 61.20 percent, the same as at the last sale on December 12, a central bank statement said.
The results of Monday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 1,801 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,000 was competitive and 801 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 4.
